name: io.github.knowledgepa3/gia-mcp-server
title: GIA Governance Intelligence Automation
description: AI governance engine — decision controls, MAI classification, compliance mapping, forensic audit chains, and human-in-the-loop gates. Runs embedded (no remote server required).

environment_variables.name: DATABASE_URL
environment_variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string for audit trail persistence (optional — governance engine works in-memory without it)

environment_variables.name: GIA_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: API key for the hosted GIA cloud platform (optional — only needed to connect to gia.aceadvising.com)
